about: Recipes written for the tests, in the phrasings meal-kit cards and home cooks use. Every recipe is rendered at every serving size and must pass CheckSteps with no findings; 'expect' pins how particular steps read. Add a recipe here whenever a new phrasing turns up (from the instruction_findings log or a report). Invented text only: never paste a real card.

recipes.name: Coconut Curry Chicken
steps: In a small pot, combine rice, ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until tender, 15-18 minutes.
Dice bell pepper. Zest and quarter lime. Thinly slice chili. Pat chicken* dry.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a pan. Add chicken and bell pepper; cook until chicken is browned. Stir in half the curry powder (all for 4 servings).

Shake coconut milk in its container. Stir ⅔ cup coconut milk (1⅓ cups for 4 servings), chili sauce, and juice from half the lime into pan. Simmer until sauce is thickened and chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Homestyle Meatballs
steps: In a large bowl, combine beef, panko, half the Parmesan, 1 TBSP water (2 TBSP for 4 servings), salt (we used ½ tsp; 1 tsp for 4), and pepper.
Roast until browned. Top with remaining Parmesan and season with salt.

recipes.name: Pasta with Reserved Water
steps: Slice mushrooms. Once water is boiling, add penne to pot. Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water, then drain.
Stir in marinara and chili flakes to taste (we used ¼ tsp). (TIP: Add more chili flakes if you like things spicy!)

1: Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water
2: Stir in marinara and chili flakes to taste (we used ¼ tsp)

recipes.name: Glazed Meatloaves
steps: In a small bowl, combine BBQ sauce, jam, and ponzu.
Cut along the tail. Brush lobster tails with 1 Tbsp BBQ glaze each. Sprinkle with Parmesan.

recipes.name: Weeknight Pantry Chili
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds, then add the ground beef and brown it, breaking it up as it cooks, 8-10 minutes. Drain off most of the fat.
Add the chili powder, cumin, 1 teaspoon salt, the tomatoes with their juices, and the drained kidney beans. Stir in 1 cup of water.
Simmer uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then. Taste and add more salt if it needs it.
Serve topped with cheddar.

recipes.name: Grandma June's Sunday Pot Roast
steps: Heat oven to 325°F. Rub the roast all over with salt and pepper.
Heat a glug of oil in the dutch oven and brown the roast good on all sides, don't rush it.
Pile the carrots, potatoes and onion around the meat. Pour in the broth and a couple shakes of Worcestershire.
Cover and bake 3 to 4 hours till it falls apart with a fork. Mom's secret: a pinch of nutmeg in the gravy!

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Chicken Thighs
steps: 1. Whisk together 1/4 cup olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 teaspoon kosher salt and 1/2 tsp pepper.
2. Put the chicken thighs in a zip-top bag, pour in the marinade, and chill for at least 1 hour or up to overnight.
3. Heat the oven to 425°F. Lay the thighs skin side up in a baking dish and pour the marinade over. Roast 35-40 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the chicken reads 165°F.
4. Sprinkle with chopped parsley if you like and serve with the pan juices.

1: Whisk together ¼ cup olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt and ½ tsp pepper.

recipes.name: Aunt Ruth's Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350 and grease a 9x5 loaf pan.
Mash the bananas in a big bowl with a fork. Stir in the melted butter.
Mix in the baking soda and salt. Stir in the sugar, beaten egg and vanilla. Mix in the flour last, just till you can't see it.
Pour into the pan and bake 55-65 min, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 min before turning it out.

2: Stir in ⅓ cup melted butter.

recipes.name: Easy Black Bean Soup
steps: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook 5-7 minutes, until soft. Add 2-3 cloves garlic and the cumin and cook 1 minute more.
Add the beans (with their liquid) and broth. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend about half the soup with an immersion blender until smooth, leaving the rest chunky.
Squeeze in the juice of the lime and season with salt and pepper to taste. Top with sour cream and cilantro, if you like.

1: Add 2-3 cloves garlic and 1 tsp cumin
4: season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Mom's Tuna Noodle Casserole

ingredients.name: a handful of crushed potato chips

steps: Heat oven to 375. Boil noodles about 6 min and drain. In the same pot stir together a can of soup, the tuna, peas, milk and most of the cheese. Fold in the noodles, dump it all into a greased 9x13 dish, and top with the rest of the cheese and the crushed chips. Bake 20-25 min till bubbly.

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Sausage and Potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F and line a large sheet pan with foil.
Toss the potatoes with 1 1/2 tablespoons of the olive oil and half of the garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper. Roast for 15 minutes.
Add the sausage and broccoli to the pan, drizzle with the remaining oil, and sprinkle with the rest of the seasonings. Toss and roast another 15-20 minutes, until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Sprinkle with parmesan and serve.

2: with 1 ½ Tbsp olive oil and ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp paprika, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper.

recipes.name: Uncle Ray's Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
steps: Mix the brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt, then rub it all over the pork.
Put the pork in the slow cooker and cook on low 8-10 hours (or high 5-6 hours).
In a small saucepan, whisk together the ketchup, vinegar, brown sugar and Worcestershire; simmer 10 minutes.
Shred the pork with two forks, discard the fat, and toss with the sauce.

1: rub it all over 4 lb pork.

recipes.name: Nonna's Weeknight Marinara
steps: Warm the oil in a wide pan over low heat. Add the sliced garlic and pepper flakes and cook gently 2 to 3 minutes; don't let the garlic brown.
Pour in the tomatoes, add a pinch of sugar and half the basil, and simmer 20 minutes while you cook the pasta.
Cook 450 grams spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Save a mug of the pasta water, then drain.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce, loosening with a splash of pasta water. Tear in the rest of the basil and pass the Parmesan at the table.
